item.title: East Donegal may experience water outages due to treatment plant interruption
item.description: East Donegal may experience water outages today due to a water treatment plant interruption. Ballybofey, Corradooey, Rooskey, Stranorlar, Glennfin, Raphoe and Convoy. Works are scheduled to take place from 2pm until 10pm. It may take four hours for water to fully restore.
